# BOTTOM SIGNALS BRIEF

Bitcoin just sat motionless while markets burned — and that silence is the loudest signal of the week.

Three macro lows across five years are printing a parallel channel so clean it's practically geometry. Distribution phase, yes — but the structure points higher. Eighty-five thousand isn't a prediction. It's math.
